title: Application model conventions overview / attributes
meaning: Application model conventions are startup-time MVC/Razor Pages model transformations.
They apply cross-cutting metadata, filters, route/action changes, ApiExplorer settings, binding metadata or parameter/property rules without repeating attributes everywhere.
Attributes are usually better for local one-off metadata; conventions are better for broad rules or centralized policies.
Outer model conventions can inspect nested models.
Conventions shape the application model before endpoint/action execution.
boundary_notes: R03/R04 cover object graph and metadata model details.
